topline.thesis: Seven consecutive goal-chains (S186-S192) polished the proof/measurement apparatus while the studio's own notes repeat the real diagnosis: the funnel is starved of traffic, not code. S187's competitive scan said it plainly — over-built infra, under-built funnel. This audit breaks the measurement-polishing loop and attacks the actual bottleneck: first-visit conversion, the acquisition loop, and making the trickle of traffic VISIBLE so it becomes actionable.

items.title: Lead the hero with PLAY, not browse — the studio's whole pitch is free browser games, no download
items.why: Since S123 the homepage hero's single primary CTA has been 'Explore Our Games' -> /games/, a brand-first detour for a studio whose entire value prop is instant, free, in-browser play. A first-time visitor needs three clicks across two domains (home -> /games/ -> external callofdoodie.wtf) before they touch a game. Promote the primary CTA to '▶ Play Free — No Download' routing straight to the live flagship, and demote 'Explore Our Games' to a ghost secondary so single-primary discipline survives. Outcome: hero -> first-play click-through, the top-of-funnel number that has been structurally flat while every session downstream got re-measured.
items.recipe: Edit index.html hero-actions (~line 1068): make the primary anchor 'Play Free — No Download' to /games/call-of-doodie/ (on-site landing, keeps session) with data-track-event=home_hero_play_click; add ghost secondary 'Explore Our Games' -> /games/. Reuse existing .button / .button-ghost classes (no new CSS). Flag the S123-evolution in DECISIONS.md (single-primary preserved, prove-first now play-first). Re-run npm run build to re-stamp the shell.

executionLog.result: Hero primary CTA now "▶ Play Free — No Download" → /games/call-of-doodie/; "Explore Our Games" demoted to ghost secondary. Single-primary discipline preserved; S123 prove-first → play-first.

items.title: Make the traffic trickle visible: bucket WHERE visitors come from, the one number 7 sessions never measured
items.why: The studio obsessively self-publishes uptime, LCP and conversion tiles for a funnel that gets ~1 event / 30 days — yet it has never measured the single most actionable thing for a traffic-starved site: which channel the trickle arrives through. Bucket the referrer (search / social / direct / referral) into api/funnel-summary.json.sources as honest-dark aggregate counts (no URLs, no PII). Outcome: turn 'we have no traffic' into 'channel X is the only one that works — double it' — an info-finding lever that makes every future acquisition effort targeted instead of blind.
items.recipe: First confirm whether referrer reaches the RUM rollup: analytics.js captures it but the /v/rum web-vitals beacon path may not. If absent, add referrer-family (computed client-side, domain-classified, never full URL) to the rum beacon + Worker allowlist + keep it in rollup (all three ends per the S189 'instrument both ends' decision). Then extend scripts/rollup-rum-ux.mjs to fold a sources{} map into api/funnel-summary.json; classify into {search,social,direct,referral,other} via a small hostname matcher; honest-dark below minSamples. Add a check-funnel-contract assertion for the new shape + a /status/ 'Where visitors come from' tile.

executionLog.result: Deferred-with-evidence: requires adding referrer-family to the RUM beacon + Worker allowlist + rollup (3 ends, S189 rule). Confirmed referrer is NOT in the /v/rum path today. Two founder P0 interrupts (Oracle + 13/13) reshaped the session; rushing a Worker-allowlist change risks the S186 silent-drop class. Carry to next session.

items.title: Turn every visitor into a distribution node — a one-tap share on each game page
items.why: share-receiver.js handles the INBOUND PWA share-target, but there is no OUTBOUND share affordance anywhere on the site — a visitor who loves a game has no one-tap way to spread it, so the acquisition loop has no viral edge. A tiny Web Share API button (clipboard fallback) on the 10 game detail pages, pre-filled with SOUL-voice copy + the game's existing OG image URL, makes each play session a potential new-visitor source. Outcome: shares per game-page session — a measurable, cost-neutral acquisition channel that attacks the traffic root cause directly.
items.recipe: New assets/share-game.js (standalone, no deps, ~80 lines): on [data-share-game] elements call navigator.share({title,text,url}) with clipboard + copy-confirmation fallback; pull title/url from the page, text from a data-attr. Add the trigger button to the game-detail template / propagate to the 10 game pages. Emit allowlisted share:{game-slug}:{shared,copied} RUM (add to Worker RUM_UX_EVENTS as a bounded prefix family via the S192 prefixAllowlist primitive; keep it in rollup-rum-ux). Idle-load via ambient-loader predicate scoped to /games/*.

executionLog.result: Deferred-with-evidence: Web Share pattern verified working on /oracle/ (line 519); game-page rollout touches 10 pages + new asset + Worker prefix-allowlist + rollup. Deferred alongside #2 for the same reason. Carry.

items.title: Win richer game SERP results with honest schema — free price, web platform, language, screenshots
items.why: All 10 game pages carry VideoGame JSON-LD but it is thin: name + description + gamePlatform. Google's game rich-results reward offers (price 0 / free), applicationCategory, operatingSystem, inLanguage and screenshot — honest fields we can assert truthfully (NO fabricated aggregateRating, which would violate the honesty canon). Outcome: richer Google game rich-results -> higher organic CTR, an acquisition lever that brings NEW humans rather than re-measuring the ones who never arrive.
items.recipe: Locate the per-game schema generator (the source that emits VideoGame blocks — likely a games data file + build step, not hand-edited HTML). Add offers{@type:Offer,price:0,priceCurrency:USD,availability:InStock}, applicationCategory:GameApplication, operatingSystem:'Any (web browser)', inLanguage:en, playMode, and screenshot (reuse OG image). Add a check that every VideoGame block validates + carries the free-offer field; never emit aggregateRating without real reviews.

executionLog.result: Removed fabricated aggregateRating(4.5/count1) from 3 game pages (honesty + SERP-spam risk) + added honest fields (offers.availability, applicationCategory, operatingSystem, inLanguage, playMode).

items.title: Stop the brief from saying 'IGNIS spend unmeasured' — produce the number it already knows how to compute
items.why: render-startup-brief reads .cache/ignis-spend.json and falls back to 'unmeasured' because check-ignis-spend.mjs has never been run to produce the cache. The capability exists; the gap is purely that nobody ran it. Outcome: a real AI-spend $ number in every future startup brief (info-finding), closing a known SIGNALS gap and honoring CANON-015 token discipline — cheap, and it removes a standing '~' from the health panel.
items.recipe: Run node scripts/check-ignis-spend.mjs to write .cache/ignis-spend.json; verify the brief renders a number. Wire the check into the build/closeout so the cache stays fresh (or a low-churn workflow). Confirm no secrets leak into any committed artifact (public-safe — commit only an aggregate if the script emits one).

items.title: Restore Doctor 13/13 — resolve the lone warning the brief has flagged since 2026-05-26
items.why: The startup brief shows Doctor 12/13 with one warning and a stale 2026-05-26 timestamp. A health probe that has sat amber for weeks is either a real un-actioned issue or a probe that needs re-running. Outcome: a clean 13/13 health signal (or, if the warning is genuine debt, an explicit logged decision) — keeps the SIGNALS panel trustworthy so a real regression is not lost in standing amber.
items.recipe: Run node scripts/ops.mjs doctor (or run-doctor.mjs) to get the live verdict + identify the warning probe. If self-healing (stale cache), re-run resolves it. If genuine, fix the underlying issue or log it in DECISIONS as accepted debt with a date. Re-render the brief so SIGNALS shows the current count.
